whatIsIt.eli5: Cuts one pile of notes into smaller piles.
whatIsIt.simple: Splits a tensor into parts along channels (C2f/C3k2 'chunk', attention q/k/v split).
whatIsIt.engineer: tensor.split(sizes, dim) / chunk(n, dim); views, no copy.

whyExists.eli5: So different parts can take different paths.
whyExists.simple: Lets only part of the channels go through expensive layers.
